app.title: OpenDPD Studio
session.required.title: Session required
session.required.body: This page needs the local session created by the URL that `opendpd gui` printed. Open that URL again, or paste the bootstrap token below.
session.token.label: Bootstrap token
session.token.invalid: The token is not valid for the running server. Restart `opendpd gui` and use the URL it prints.
state.error.title: Something went wrong
state.empty.title: Nothing here yet
state.disconnected.title: Live updates disconnected
state.disconnected.body: Reconnecting… last update {time}. The run keeps going on the server; refresh to fetch the latest snapshot.
status.stale: Log disconnected: no heartbeat for over a minute
evidence.mock.hint: Mock data for interface development; not a computed result and never exportable.
evidence.pa_modeling.hint: How well the model reproduces the measured PA output. Not a DPD result.
evidence.dpd_surrogate.hint: DPD evaluated against the trained PA model, not against a real PA.
evidence.dpd_measured.hint: DPD evaluated with real PA measurements.
home.title: Home
home.example.title: Example: DPA_200MHz
home.example.body: Built-in measured data from a 200 MHz digital PA. Register it, then train the smoke recipe to see the whole workflow in a few minutes.
home.noRuns: No runs yet. Start with the example dataset and a smoke recipe.
datasets.title: Datasets
datasets.empty: No datasets registered. Register the built-in example or import your own data (import arrives with Dataset Doctor).
datasets.importOwn.soon: CSV/NumPy import with Dataset Doctor is a later stage (S07); the built-in example works today.
datasets.detail.doctor.soon: Dataset Doctor reports arrive with S07. Below is the mock report used to design this panel.
experiments.title: Experiments
form.title: New experiment
form.recipe.help: A recipe fixes the model and training settings for a purpose. Smoke recipes prove the pipeline; they are not benchmarks.
form.paRun.help: DPD training needs a succeeded PA model run on the same dataset.
form.paRun.none: No succeeded PA run on this dataset yet.
form.device.untested: no recorded evidence for this model on {device}
form.name: Name (optional)
form.smokeBanner: Smoke recipe: a few epochs to prove the pipeline. Results are not a benchmark.
run.title: Run
run.notFound: This run does not exist in the current workspace.
run.cancel.confirm: Cancel this run? Artifacts produced so far are kept.
run.metrics.title: Validation and test metrics per epoch
run.metrics.empty: Metrics appear after the first epoch.
run.next.failed: Read the error and hint, fix the configuration, then retry as a new run.
run.next.interrupted: The service stopped while this run was active. Retry as a new run.
run.next.cancelled: Cancelled on request. Retry as a new run if needed.
run.next.succeeded: Open the result to see metrics with their evidence type.
run.next.queued: Waiting for a free device. Cancel if you no longer need it.
run.artifacts.empty: Artifacts are registered when the run finishes.
run.artifacts.incomplete: One or more required artifacts are missing; the manifest is incomplete.
results.title: Results
results.empty: No results yet. A result is written when a PA or DPD run succeeds.
results.detail.charts.soon: Spectrum and time-domain views from the evaluation arrive in S11; the component gallery shows them on mock data.
settings.title: Settings
settings.devices.note: Detected means the driver reports the device. Tested means a model has recorded evidence on it. One does not imply the other.
gallery.title: Component gallery
gallery.body: Every domain component rendered on fixed mock fixtures generated from the contract examples. Nothing here is a computed result.
gallery.perf: Performance probe: PSD with {psd} points × {traces} traces and an I/Q window of {iq} samples rendered in {ms} ms.
diff.title: Configuration differences
chart.spectrum.title: Power spectral density
chart.iq.title: I/Q time window
